title: Jumbo Smoky Canadian Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Canadian dish featuring tender lamb and a rich smoky broth, made quick and easy with the help of sous-vide cooking and a macrobiotic-friendly bouquet garni.

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder
ingredients.notes: boneless and cut into large chunks

ingredients.name: bouquet garni
ingredients.notes: containing thyme, rosemary, and bay leaves

instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 180 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb chunks with smoked paprika and a pinch of salt.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the lamb chunks until browned on all sides.
Transfer the lamb to a large sous-vide bag and add the chopped onions, sliced carrots, cubed potatoes, minced garlic, and bouquet garni.
Pour in the lamb broth and seal the bag, making sure to remove as much air as possible.
Submerge the bag in the preheated sous-vide machine and cook for 4 hours.
Remove the bag from the machine and let it cool slightly before opening and serving the stew hot.
Discard the bouquet garni and serve the stew in large bowls, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
